title: Baseline and numerical qualification for the WL104K-C paired comparison protocol
classification: Suffix follow-up of WL104K-B (owner-named WL104K-C). Stage A is run and committed before the WL104K-C main protocol (protocol.json) is frozen. WL104K-B's frozen verdict (decision.json, Amendment 1 NOT_CONSISTENT, labels UNQUALIFIED) is NOT revised by anything in this batch.
host: local RTX 5080, .venv-cu128 (Torch 2.8.0+cu128). Owner instruction 2026-11-24: this batch uses at most 50 % of the GPU. Every WL104K-C GPU process runs under gpu_duty.ps1 (duty-cycle suspension, estimated own share target 0.45, logged in results/ecro_wl84_104kc/gpu_duty/) with the torch allocator capped at 50 % of device memory. Neither changes any numerical operation (checked: an 800-step fit under the supervisor reproduced the unthrottled median final objective exactly).
pre_registration_note: Before this file was written, one 20-step debugging run of stageA104kc.py shape (scratch output, not evidence) showed: forward pieces bitwise identical across layouts; gradients differ between batch shapes 72 / 36 / 9 (max rel 5e-5 to 7e-5) but not under content swap or start permutation at shape 72; per-step objectives diverge from step 3-16 at shapes 36 / 9. The qualification rules below were written after that observation; they do not depend on any angular, scene or held-out quantity.

runs.R4: fit104kb.py UNCHANGED (via run_kb.py): adam, train_original, original objective, --starts 4 (WL104K four-start batching: 36 units, start-major), 12,000 steps. = the historical WL104K P configuration.
runs.R8: fit104kb.py UNCHANGED: as R4 with --starts 8 (72 units) = WL104K-B O0 configuration.
runs.S_O0r: fit104kb.py UNCHANGED: --synthetic, adam, train_original, original objective, --starts 4 = WL104K-B S_O0 configuration.
runs.S_Dr: fit104kb.py UNCHANGED: --synthetic, adam, train_coverage (WL104K-B data, authenticated), original objective, --starts 4 = WL104K-B S_D configuration.
runs.shape: stageA104kc.py shape: layouts L72 (8 starts), L72swap (positions of starts 5-8 hold different starts 104918-104921), L72perm (start order reversed), L36 (4 starts), L9 (generic start only). Per-unit decoded parameters, lane responses, group terms, objective and gradient at the WL104K-B starts and at the WL104K-B O0 final states; first 500 steps of the original 12,000-step O0 schedule per layout with per-step objectives and the 500-step states.

qualification.Q1_historical: R4 final states bitwise equal to the archived WL104K P 12k states for all 36 units (fit_primary/states.npz, WL104K manifest authentication).
qualification.Q2_control: R8 final states bitwise equal to WL104K-B fits/O0 for all 72 units.
qualification.Q3_content_invariance: At fixed shape 72, units of starts 1-4 have bitwise identical per-step objectives for 500 steps and identical 500-step states whether positions 5-8 hold starts 104914-104917 or 104918-104921. Also: the L72 trajectory equals the logged WL104K-B O0 history (steps 0-500).
qualification.Q4_synthetic: S_O0r and S_Dr final states bitwise equal to WL104K-B S_O0 and S_D (36 units each).
qualification.verdict: BASELINE_QUALIFIED iff Q1-Q4 all pass. Otherwise BASELINE_NOT_QUALIFIED: the primary causal experiment (Stages B-D) is not run and the blocking evidence is reported.

attribution.batching: Differences between R8 (starts 1-4) and R4 are the batch-size effect (same code, data, starts, schedule; only the number of units in the batch differs). If Q1 and Q2 pass, every WL104K-B O0-vs-archived-P difference is explained by batching; the unexplained remainder is the number of units failing Q1 or Q2.
attribution.mechanism: Reported from the shape diagnostic: which computation (decoded parameters, lane response, group terms, objective, gradient) first differs between layouts, and at which step the trajectories first diverge.
attribution.position: L72perm is reported (position invariance); it is not a qualification rule because the paired protocol fixes positions.

numerical_sensitivity.set: WL104K-B DEV lane set and dev peak grid (development data; never the WL104K-C test).
numerical_sensitivity.measure: Per (start 1-4, material): metric(R4) - metric(R8), mean over the 20 dev probes, for el1, ealb, eshape, e_core, e_shoulder, core / shoulder / tail region L1, grazing el1, e_prof, e_h, s_h. Compared with the across-start SD per material within R8 (8 starts, ddof 1). Pooled relative change R4 vs R8 (starts 1-4) per metric = the batch-size numerical null used by the main protocol. Reported separately from random-start variability; not a qualification rule.
numerical_sensitivity.role: Sets the numerical-null reference for WL104K-C contrasts (main protocol).

paired_protocol_if_qualified: Every WL104K-C physical arm is computed at the fixed shape of 72 units (9 materials x 8 starts, start-major, WL104K-B order) and warm-started from R8 (= WL104K-B O0) where it is a continuation; synthetic arms at the fixed shape of 36 units (4 starts). Arms are compared paired by (material, start). The batch-size null is reported next to every contrast.
